## Activity

This report covers activity at East City Eye Clinic during April 2019. The site recorded 180 captures during the month. The capture total is presented as the activity measure for the reporting period and provides the basis for the image quality and grading information below. No additional activity measure is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 180 captures recorded in April 2019, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7. This image quality result is reported alongside the total capture activity to show the number of captures that could not proceed to grading. The figures represent the recorded outcome for the reporting month at East City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This is the reported median interval for the month and is provided with the referable result count. Together, these figures summarise the grading outcome for the 180 captures completed at East City Eye Clinic in April 2019.
